changelog.text: Phase 2 foundation: initial signed catalogue release (2026-09-24)

2026-09-25: United Kingdom added as catalogue country (60 gb-* schemes, uk-* packs, £ currency, UK £60k soft gate; India bands India-only); URL tickets fixed (nsap-nfbs -> nsap.dord.gov.in; AP NTR Bharosa + Sikkim SUWPS re-verified). 882 schemes.

2026-09-25: Canada added as catalogue country (67 can-* schemes: 29 federal + 38 provincial/territorial; canada-* packs; C$ currency; Canada C$58,523 soft gate; India bands and US gate never applied); India freshness candidates: PM-JANMAN added (in-pm-janman), PM-KUSUM + SVAMITVA deferred, Jal Jeevan Mission / PM SHRI / PM e-Bus Sewa rejected as infrastructure. 950 schemes.

2026-09-25: official phase-out zero-points as max_annual_income — CCB C$318,300, CDB C$266,005, OCB C$114,861, BCFB C$170,937, ACFB C$70,143, OTB C$117,971, NB HST credit C$85,000, NWT CB C$80,000, NS ALTC C$39,900; UK Tax-Free Childcare / England working-parent childcare / Wales Childcare Offer £200,000 (2 x per-parent £100k). 950 schemes.
